synopsis: Energy is the story this morning. Brent surged 3% to $94.39 and WTI jumped 3.3% to $88.67 after Ukraine struck Russia's Taneco refinery deep inland and a Black Sea oil terminal, deepening Moscow's second wave of gasoline shortages, while European TTF gas rallied 3.2% through €65/MWh for the first time since March — EU storage at just 62% keeping the winter supply premium alive.
